tools.name: safe4_price
tools.description:
Price and accepted payment networks for one Safe4 decision.

Free to call. Returns the same x402 terms the HTTP endpoint advertises,
so an agent can see the cost before committing to a paid call.

tools.name: safe4_authorize
tools.description:
Decide whether a proposed agent payment should proceed.

Settled per call in USDC over x402. Called without ``payment`` it
returns the price list rather than a decision; call it again with the
signed payload to receive one.
